about: Questions written blind from merged rust-lang/rust PRs (June to November 2026), without seeing the guide; answers labeled separately against the pinned guide.

labeling.method: Two independent labelers per question (one starting from the doc list, one from grep); a third agent reconciled every disagreement on the merits.

cases.task: Respect `--color=never` when printing `--explain` output to the terminal
cases.question: After building with x, how do I run my locally built rustc by hand to check the `--explain` output?
cases.note: Link the build with `rustup toolchain link stage1 build/host/stage1`, then run `rustc +stage1 ...` (e.g. with --explain).

cases.task: LoongArch: Restore `feature(stdarch_loongarch)` for bootstrap
cases.question: When do I need `cfg(bootstrap)` or `cfg(not(bootstrap))` around feature attributes, and which code does the stage0 compiler build?
cases.note: Stage0 builds get --cfg bootstrap, so just-stabilized features use cfg_attr(bootstrap, feature(..)). Stage0 compiles compiler/rustc and src/bootstrap.

cases.task: [tiny] Add missing backticks around lifetime name
cases.question: After changing a diagnostic's wording, how do I update every affected UI test .stderr file automatically?
cases.note: Run `./x test tests/ui --bless` to regenerate the .stderr/.stdout/.fixed snapshots after changing diagnostic output.

cases.task: Add regression tests for transmutability issues
cases.question: How can one UI test file be compiled under several different flag sets, each with its own expected stderr?
cases.note: Use `//@ revisions: a b` with `//@[a] compile-flags: ...`. Each revision gets its own test.a.stderr file.

cases.task: Point at prior token on `let` when expression is expected
cases.question: After moving an error's span to the previous line, compiletest says my `//~ ERROR` annotation wasn't found. How do annotations target other lines?
cases.note: Bullets/examples: `//~^` one caret per line above, `//~v` below, `//~|` previous annotation's line; adding Step 3 shows `//~^`.

cases.task: Add regression test for #162109
cases.question: Which directory under tests/ui should a new regression test go in, and should the file be named after the issue number?
cases.note: Use a meaningful subdirectory, not tests/ui itself or tests/ui/issues. Name the file descriptively, issue number in comments or as a suffix only.

cases.task: Add regression test for self referential inherent associated type ICE
cases.question: If my fix resolves an ICE whose reproducer lives in tests/crashes, what should I do with that test file?
cases.note: Crash tests section: move it to a fitting tests/ui subdirectory, give it a meaningful name, add a doc comment and `Fixes #N` in the PR.

cases.task: Add regression tests for #156380
cases.question: tidy fails on my new UI test because some lines exceed the length limit; how do I exempt that file?
cases.note: Line length section: add a `// ignore-tidy-linelength` comment near the top of the file.

cases.task: Cleanup `rustdoc-html` tests
cases.question: In tests/rustdoc-html, how do `//@ has` and `//@ matches` checks work, and how do I target an element with XPath?
cases.note: Intro XPath example; `has PATH XPATH PATTERN` normalized text match, `matches` regex; Limitations: XPATH must start with `//`.

cases.task: Add `vec_visualizer` lldb test
cases.question: How do I write a debuginfo test that runs LLDB commands and checks the printed output of a Vec?
cases.note: compiletest: //@ lldb-command / lldb-check, // #break, -g example; debuginfo/testing: preferred lldb-repr directive plus --bless.

cases.task: Remove the unused generic Graphviz writer
cases.question: How do I dump a function's MIR before and after each pass, including as a graphviz graph, to see what changed?
cases.note: -Z dump-mir=F writes before/after MIR for every pass to mir_dump; -Z dump-mir-graphviz writes .dot graphs.

cases.task: diagnostic: skip wrong loops when explaining borrow errors
cases.question: How do I turn on the compiler's debug! logging for just the borrowck diagnostics module while compiling a test case?
cases.note: RUSTC_LOG=path::to::module=debug rustc file.rs; debug! output requires rust.debug-logging = true in bootstrap.toml.

cases.task: Improve delayed bug comment and message on first_method_vtable_slot
cases.question: An ICE reports a delayed bug at the end of compilation; how do I get a backtrace from where it was originally created?
cases.note: Debugging delayed bugs: -Z eagerly-emit-delayed-bugs plus -Z treat-err-as-bug stops at the delayed bug for a backtrace.

cases.task: perf: avoid allocating HashSet in is_distinct check on small SwitchInts
cases.question: How do I get an official perf benchmark run on my PR to check whether this optimization actually improves compile times?
cases.note: An authorized user comments `@bors try @rust-timer queue` on the PR; the try-builds section repeats it.

cases.task: Add context span showing item that can't be annotated
cases.question: How do I add an extra labeled span pointing at another item to a diagnostic struct that uses `#[derive(Diagnostic)]`?
cases.note: Add a Span field annotated #[label("...")] (prev_span example); Option<Span> makes the label optional.

cases.task: Suggest `gca!` for path const args that use generic params
cases.question: How do I choose the Applicability for a new suggestion — when is MachineApplicable appropriate versus MaybeIncorrect or HasPlaceholders?
cases.note: Says be conservative; defines MachineApplicable, HasPlaceholders, MaybeIncorrect and Unspecified applicability levels.

cases.task: [tiny] Properly format return type in lifetime error with backticks
cases.question: What are the style rules for compiler diagnostic messages, such as backticks around code, capitalization, and trailing punctuation?
cases.note: Structure: backticks around code, no capitals or periods; style guide: lowercase start, no trailing punctuation, more rules.

cases.task: [tiny] Include trait definition line when pointing at assoc function in E0308
cases.question: Where do the long explanations for error codes like E0308, the ones `rustc --explain` prints, live in the repository?
cases.note: Markdown files in compiler/rustc_error_codes/src/error_codes/EXXXX.md, registered in the error_codes! macro.

cases.task: Unstably introduce MVP edition migration lint `unmarked_unchecked_type_aliases` together with bikeshed attribute `#[rustc_unchecked_type_alias]`
cases.question: How do I declare a new edition migration lint so it joins the edition compatibility group and `cargo fix --edition` applies it?
cases.note: @future_incompatible with EditionError/EditionSemanticsChange reason joins rust-20xx-compatibility, which cargo fix --edition force-warns.

cases.task: Gate `z` inline asm template modifier
cases.question: How do I add a new unstable feature gate and emit the standard feature-gate error when code uses it without `#![feature]`?
cases.note: Steps: add symbol, declare in rustc_feature unstable.rs, check tcx.features(), emit feature_err or gate spans/gate_all!.

cases.task: Const-stabilize `{BinaryHeap, BTreeMap, BTreeSet, LinkedList, VecDeque)::{len, is_empty}`
cases.question: What attributes do I change to const-stabilize a library method that is already stable as a normal function?
cases.note: Replace #[rustc_const_unstable] with #[rustc_const_stable(since = "CURRENT_RUSTC_VERSION")] (step 4 of library stabilization).

cases.task: Stabilize `slice_split_once`
cases.question: When stabilizing a library API, what version should go in `#[stable(since = ...)]` if I don't know the release yet?
cases.note: Step 2: change #[unstable] to #[stable(since = "CURRENT_RUSTC_VERSION")].

cases.task: Add -Zasync-panic flag
cases.question: Where do I declare a new unstable `-Z` command-line flag for rustc, and how do I read its value in the compiler?
cases.note: Add to UnstableOptions in rustc_session/src/options.rs; read via sess.opts.unstable_opts.<flag>.

cases.task: Move `doc(keyword)` and `doc(attribute)` attributes checks from `rustc_passes` to `rustc_attr_parsing`
cases.question: How do I move an attribute's validation into rustc_attr_parsing — what parser do I implement for a builtin attribute?
cases.note: Implement NoArgs/Single/Combine/AttributeParser trait in rustc_attr_parsing, register it; leftover checks in check_attr.rs.

cases.task: Declare `SyntaxContext` through `rustc_index::newtype_index!`
cases.question: What does a SyntaxContext represent for hygiene, and how does it relate to ExpnId and macro expansion marks?
cases.note: SyntaxContext is an ID for a chain of ExpnId marks built with apply_mark; the parent section introduces ExpnId.

cases.task: [small] Tweak suggestions in struct literal resolve errors
cases.question: How is rustc_resolve structured — which paths get resolved during early resolution versus late resolution of function bodies?
cases.note: Intro and Basics: imports/macros resolved during expansion; all remaining names in rustc_resolve::late afterwards.

cases.task: Add regression test for new solver hang on cyclic projection bound
cases.question: How does the next-generation trait solver handle cycles between goals, and which cycles count as coinductive rather than errors?
cases.note: Cycles resolved by provisional-result fixpoint; inductive cycles start as overflow; only auto traits, Sized, WF are coinductive.

cases.task: handle higher-ranked preds in imperfect derives diagnostic
cases.question: How are higher-ranked predicates represented with Binder, and when is skip_binder safe versus instantiating the bound vars?
cases.note: How Binder represents bound vars, and why/how to instantiate before accessing the inside; skip_binder itself is never named.

cases.task: remove unnecessary fast path from borrowck
cases.question: What are the main phases the MIR borrow checker goes through, and where does region inference fit in?
cases.note: Bullet list of borrowck phases; region inference runs after MIR type check, before borrows-in-scope and error walk.

cases.task: copy_nonoverlapping: dont skip ovelrap check when src is fully uninit
cases.question: How does the const-eval interpreter represent memory, including tracking which bytes are initialized and pointer provenance?
cases.note: Memory section: Allocation bytes, AllocId+offset pointers, relocations store provenance out-of-band, undef_mask tracks initialized bytes.

cases.task: avoid exporting non-instantiable mono items
cases.question: How does the monomorphization collector decide which mono items to codegen, and how are they partitioned into codegen units?
cases.note: Collection section covers collector and collect_and_partition_mono_items; CGU partitioning section covers stable/volatile CGU split.

cases.task: Remove `TypeKind` from `rustc_codegen_ssa`
cases.question: How is codegen split between the backend-agnostic rustc_codegen_ssa crate and backends like LLVM, GCC and Cranelift?
cases.note: Whole doc: rustc_codegen_ssa traits/generics interface implemented by backends; part-5-intro only one-line summary, excluded.

cases.task: Avoid stdlib's `impl Hash for Discriminant` for stable hashing
cases.question: Why do query results need HashStable, and why isn't std's Hash impl good enough for incremental fingerprints?
cases.note: Fingerprints section: query results hashed stably (DefId hashed as DefPath) so fingerprints compare across sessions.

cases.task: Clippy subtree update
cases.question: What's the procedure for pulling the latest changes from the clippy repository into its subtree in rust-lang/rust?
cases.note: Clippy is a git subtree: push first, subtree pull with -P prefix, never rebase; exact steps in Clippy guide.

cases.task: Update cargo submodule
cases.question: After switching branches, git status shows src/tools/cargo as modified with new commits; how do I reset the submodules properly?
cases.note: Quick note shows exact 'new commits' status, fix is git submodule update; hard-reset covers modified-content variant.

cases.task: Remove test-aarch64-apple-* jobs temporarily
cases.question: Where are CI jobs like the aarch64-apple test runners defined, so I can temporarily remove them from merge builds?
cases.note: Auto (merge) jobs are defined in the auto section of jobs.yml; Modifying CI jobs says edit that file.

dropped.question: Running the mir-opt tests with --bless only updated the panic-unwind files; how do I regenerate the panic-abort variants too?
dropped.reason: compiletest#mir-opt-tests only names EMIT_MIR_FOR_EACH_PANIC_STRATEGY and never says how to bless the panic-abort variants (which targets to use).

dropped.task: Only recover if we may for `recover_missing_dot`
dropped.question: How does parser error recovery work, and why are some contexts, like parsing macro arguments, not allowed to recover?
dropped.reason: Only one-line mentions of recovery (glossary, overview); nothing explains how parser recovery works or why macro-argument parsing may not recover.

dropped.question: When should a PR be marked rollup=never or rollup=iffy instead of being allowed into a rollup?
dropped.reason: No doc mentions rollup=never or rollup=iffy or their criteria; tests/ci#rollups and pr-lifecycle#r-1 only say trivial PRs get rolled up.

dropped.question: This rollup's merge build failed on a flaky-looking test unrelated to any included PR; how do I get bors to retry it?
dropped.reason: No doc gives the @bors retry command or how to handle spurious merge failures; tests/ci#merging-prs-serially-with-bors only says in passing that a failed PR must be re-approved.
